title: My Black Hole: Ring
caption: A black hole bends the light of its glowing disc into a ring as distant nebulae drift behind it.

provenance.creatorOrAgency: Your Name; NASA, ESA, CSA, and STScI

provenance.modificationNotes: A non-spinning black hole computed by Schwarzschild ray tracing with the Locus black-hole tools. Disc turbulence, temperatures, exposure, flares, glow, time compression and the slow drift of the sky are artistic. Two Webb images sit on a procedural starfield, dimmed about three stops and added as light above their own black level: the Tarantula Nebula (weic2212a) behind the hole and the Southern Ring Nebula (weic2207b) opposite it. This is a composition, not a view from any real place.
